caption: The image shows a detailed drawing of a drawstring bag with a blue fabric top and a decorative, embroidered main section. The blue top is gathered with a drawstring cord on both sides. The main section features a needlepoint pattern composed of colorful threads forming a variety of motifs. At the center, there is a yellow bird perched amid green foliage, surrounded by large pink and red roses, with smaller blue, yellow, and purple flowers interspersed. The background of the embroidery is a pale gray with repeated diagonal light blue stripes on the upper section. The lower section of the bag is bordered by a red band decorated with floral patterns and leaves in green, pink, and turquoise, as well as a series of numbers and letters, including "1831." The contour of the bag at the bottom is angular, with the lower part being dark red with green and pink accents. The drawing is signed at the bottom right with the name "C. Christofle, del."
title: Bag
